items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Simply select a service from the Pricelist above or click the order button. You will be connected directly to our official WhatsApp admin with a ready-to-send order template.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept payments via QRIS (scan with DANA, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, or any Mobile Banking), direct Bank Transfer, and SociaBuzz Tribe.

items.question: How long is the processing time?
items.answer: Processing time depends on the current queue. Note: If there are no urgent queues, orders are processed as quickly as possible!

items.question: Are transactions at Justdhif Store safe & guaranteed?
items.answer: Yes, 100% safe and guaranteed! Since our store is newly launched, transaction proof is still growing. You can view genuine transaction receipts & testimonials directly in our WhatsApp Channel above.
